reader_summary.headline: Reade Griffith is the co-founder and Chief Investment Officer of Tetragon and Polygon.
reader_summary.overview: Reade Griffith is the co-founder and Chief Investment Officer of Tetragon and Polygon. Tetragon is a European-listed public holding company with $38 billion in assets. Polygon is a $1 billion European event-driven hedge fund within Tetragon that Reade co-founded in 2002 and still serves as its portfolio manager.

key_points.text: Tetragon is a European-listed public holding company with $38 billion in assets.
Our conversation covers Reade's path to investing and experience at hedge funds dating back to the early 1990s.
We discuss the founding of Polygon and Tetragon, managing volatility and macro risk, event-driven investing, and TFG Asset Management's partnerships with managers across sourcing.
